column1: # The Node execution options the fast path implements (ADR 0026, 1.11). The engine admits a launch only
# with these (crates/oxidevm-userspace/src/runtime/exec/native_addon/node_options.rs) and the SDK applies them
# (packages/sdk/src/runtime/protocol/node-options.ts). Both replay every row; the SDK keeps a copy pinned by SHA-256.
# Fields are tab-separated. Values are bytes, percent-encoded outside printable ASCII and for % and ~; ~ alone is
# the empty string. A list is values separated by single spaces.
#   option  <runtime: node, bun, or node-options for NODE_OPTIONS>  <index of the first argument that is not an option, or !refused>  <arguments>
